description: This file contains the implementation of the EmailConfigurationListener class, which is an event listener for the EmailConfiguration entity in a Doctrine ORM context. It handles encryption and decryption of SMTP password fields during entity persistence and loading events.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationListener
classes.description: An event listener for EmailConfiguration entity that manages encrypting SMTP passwords before persisting or updating, and decrypting after loading.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Encrypts SMTP password before entity is persisted if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts SMTP password before entity update if encryption is enabled and the password field has changed.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts SMTP password after entity update if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts SMTP password after entity is loaded if encryption is enabled.
